title: ClickFix Investigation & CrowdStrike Hunting
summary: Lab investigation of a ClickFix (fake CAPTCHA, Win+R paste) intrusion with host artifacts, a timeline and nine CrowdStrike Falcon Advanced Event Search hunting queries.

title: Hunting Distributed Attacks with JA4
summary: Method for clustering a distributed web attack that rotates IPs and User-Agents using JA4 TLS fingerprints, with Splunk and KQL hunting queries and mitigation guidance.

title: IOC Checker (open source)
summary: Browser-based tool that extracts and sanitizes IPs, domains, hashes, URLs and JA3/JA4 fingerprints, then searches many threat intel platforms at once. No API keys, no backend, with tests.

title: SOC Hunting Queries (open source)
summary: Hunting and detection query templates for CrowdStrike Falcon, Splunk and Sentinel KQL, each with data needs, ATT&CK mapping, false positives and next steps.

title: Sigma Detection Rules (open source)
summary: 20 Sigma rules for Windows threat hunting (ClickFix, PowerShell, ransomware precursors, credential theft, lateral movement) with ATT&CK mapping, false-positive notes, CI that converts every rule to Splunk and KQL, and an ATT&CK coverage map.

title: DFIR Toolkit (open source)
summary: Small offline command-line tools with tests: IOC extraction and defanging, file hashing with lookup links, JA3/JA4 fingerprint stacking from captures, and Windows event log triage.

title: DFIR Cheatsheets (open source)
summary: Quick-reference notes for investigations: Windows artifacts, event IDs, persistence locations, a first-30-minutes triage checklist, PowerShell and Linux command references, and CrowdStrike RTR.

title: Home Network Segmentation (Alta Labs)
summary: Migrated a home network to Alta Labs gear (Route10 gateway, AP6-Pro access points) with VLAN segmentation for trusted, IoT and lab devices, and firewall rules between zones.

summary: System, network, and security engineer at Qatar Emiri Naval Forces Base site office
